theory.heading: What Distillation of Large Models is
theory.body: Distillation of Large Models describes the methods and patterns used within AI Engineering to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: Distillation of Large Models is a named, repeatable concept.

theory.heading: Why Distillation of Large Models matters
theory.body: Without Distillation of Large Models, systems built with AI Engineering are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How Distillation of Large Models works
theory.body: The mechanism behind Distillation of Large Models follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Distillation of Large Models
theory.body: Distillation of Large Models offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
